## What's new

- MENU > ScreenScraper is now its own page: your account, Sign Out, and a
  Developer ID. ScreenScraper wants every app to send one, and ChaOS
  builds don't include one, so you can add your own (free, from the
  screenscraper.fr forum). ChaOS checks it with ScreenScraper first.
- Both are kept outside ChaOS's own files, so Update and Full Install
  leave them in place.

---

ChaOS 0.9.5 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.9.5-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.9.5-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
